say:4:1210102002:1.text: Luckily, there is a small island here. Otherwise, we would've drowned.
say:4:1210102002:1.source_cn: 幸好这里有座小岛，不然我们早就被海浪淹没了！

say:5:1210102003:1.source_cn: 你们看到了吗，那些大雾一瞬间就从海面上升了起来，明明刚...

say:6:1210102004:1.text: And now we're in the middle of the ocean! How could this have happened?!
say:6:1210102004:1.source_cn: 咱们可是在大海中心呀，附近连一片岛屿都没有！怎么会在大...

say:9:1210102006:0.source_cn: 满满的帽子歪了而已，没事！
say:9:1210102006:0.male: Chippy's helmet is a little crooked, but it's alright.
say:9:1210102006:0.female: Chippy's helmet is a little crooked, but it's alright.

say:10:1210102007:0.text: Yes, first mate reporting! No suspicious creatures in sight. It should be safe here.
say:10:1210102007:0.source_cn: 报——报告！满满没有发现可疑的生物，暂定安全！

say:10:1210102007:0.female: Yes, first mate reporting! No suspicious creatures in sight. It should be safe here.

choice:7:1:2.text: Chippy, my first mate, is it safe here?
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 满满大副，周围是否安全？
choice:7:1:2.male: Chippy, my first mate, is it safe here?
choice:7:1:2.female: Chippy, my first mate, is it safe here?

say:11:1210102008:0.text: Navigator? Are you talking to me?
say:11:1210102008:0.male: Navigator? Are you talking to me?
say:11:1210102008:0.female: Navigator? Are you talking to me?

say:12:1210102009:0.text: Umm... We have poor visibility because of the fog. Other than that, all seems well.
say:12:1210102009:0.source_cn: 唔，周围水雾很浓，能见度也差，但看起来还算安全。

choice:7:2:3.source_cn: 漫漫导航士，你有什么建议？

say:15:1210102011:0.text: Alright, Chippy will scout on ahead. Magister, Hammie, you two try to stay safe.
say:15:1210102011:0.source_cn: 那……那满满在前面探路，主人，漫漫，你们小心。
say:15:1210102011:0.male: Alright, Chippy will scout on ahead. Magister, Hammie, you two try to stay safe.
say:15:1210102011:0.female: Alright, Chippy will scout on ahead. Magister, Hammie, you two try to stay safe.

say:16:1210102012:0.text: Chippy hopes we won't be trapped here forever...
say:16:1210102012:0.source_cn: 希望我们没有被彻底困在这座岛上！

choice:14:1:2.text: Maybe there's another way off this island.
choice:14:1:2.male: Maybe there's another way off this island.
choice:14:1:2.female: Maybe there's another way off this island.

say:0:1210103001:0.text: Magister, there's a boat over there!
say:0:1210103001:0.source_cn: 主人，前面好像有一艘船！
say:0:1210103001:0.male: Magister, there's a boat over there!
say:0:1210103001:0.female: Magister, there's a boat over there!

say:2:1210104001:0.text: Oh, it seems we're not the only ones who had bad luck at sea. I wonder who left this boat here...
say:2:1210104001:0.source_cn: 看来在海上遇难的人不止我们，不知道是谁弃下了这艘船……

say:3:1210104002:0.text: Chippy, what do you think? Can we still use it?

say:5:1210104003:0.text: It looks alright... Just a bit of damage, but we can fix the holes with some wood.
say:5:1210104003:0.source_cn: 看起来……没问题！只有一点小损伤，用木板补一补能修好。

say:6:1210104004:1.text: But should we really use this boat? Look, it even has a strange symbol on the sail.
say:6:1210104004:1.source_cn: 不过，我们要换用这艘船吗？你们看，还挂着这么奇怪的船帆。

picture:6::2.text: A tattered banner featuring bones and sharp claws.
picture:6::2.source_cn: 画着骨头和利爪的破旧旗帜

say:7:1210104005:0.text: Hmm... I can't tell if the symbol is a claw or a bone...
say:7:1210104005:0.source_cn: 唔，看不出来是什么标志，有点像爪子，也很像骨头……

say:8:1210104006:0.text: I know this is someone else's boat, but we can still borrow it, can't we?
say:8:1210104006:0.source_cn: 这是别人的弃船吧，我们可以借用吗……？
say:8:1210104006:0.male: I know this is someone else's boat, but we can still borrow it, can't we?
say:8:1210104006:0.female: I know this is someone else's boat, but we can still borrow it, can't we?

choice_prompt:9:1210104006.female: I know this is someone else's boat, but we can still borrow it, can't we?

say:10:1210104007:0.text: Yes! We can finally leave this island... Achoo!
say:10:1210104007:0.source_cn: 总算可以离开这座岛了……阿欠！

say:11:1210104008:0.text: If we stay here any longer, Chippy is going to catch a cold.
say:11:1210104008:0.source_cn: 再待下去，满满都要冻生病了。

say:12:1210104009:1.text: The sudden fog, the reefs here, and the abandoned boat... This place is a little eerie.
say:12:1210104009:1.source_cn: 突如其来的大雾，海面中的礁石，还有孤零零的弃船……这片...

say:13:1210104010:1.text: Let's go find some wood. I think it's best to leave this island as soon as possible.
say:13:1210104010:1.source_cn: 我们快去找木头吧，最好尽快离开这座小岛，找个安全的港口停靠！

choice:9:2:3.text: There are no other boats around.
choice:9:2:3.male: There are no other boats around.
choice:9:2:3.female: There are no other boats around.

say:0:1210105001:0.text: Yes! We have enough wood. Let's go back and repair the boat! Chippy doesn't like it here either.
say:0:1210105001:0.source_cn: 木材收集完了，回去修船吧！满满也想早点离开。

narration:0:1210105101:1.text: After working on the boat for some time...

say:2:1210106001:0.text: Captain, Chippy has repaired the boat!
say:2:1210106001:0.source_cn: 报告船长，满满已经把弃船修好了！
say:2:1210106001:0.male: Captain, Chippy has repaired the boat!
say:2:1210106001:0.female: Captain, Chippy has repaired the boat!

say:3:1210106002:0.text: Permission to depart? Wait, the fog hasn't cleared up yet, though...
say:3:1210106002:0.source_cn: 要现在出发吗？但是，雾还没有散……
say:3:1210106002:0.male: Permission to depart? Wait, the fog hasn't cleared up yet, though...
say:3:1210106002:0.female: Permission to depart? Wait, the fog hasn't cleared up yet, though...

say:8:1210106004:0.text: Yes, you're right, Magister. Heroes aren't afraid of anything. Let's set sail right now.

say:8:1210106004:0.male: Yes, you're right, Magister. Heroes aren't afraid of anything. Let's set sail right now.
say:8:1210106004:0.female: Yes, you're right, Magister. Heroes aren't afraid of anything. Let's set sail right now.

choice:7:0:1.female: We have to set sail now.

say:1:1210108002:0.source_cn: ……前面是不是有亮光？难道前面有城市吗？

say:6:1210109003:0.male: Really...? You didn't seem like you enjoyed choking on seawater.
say:6:1210109003:0.female: Really...? You didn't seem like you enjoyed choking on seawater.

say:7:1210109006:1.female: Who are you? Why were you drifting out there <style="highlight">alone</style>?

choice:5:0:1.male: Yes, I was enjoying the water.
choice:5:0:1.female: Yes, I was enjoying the water.

say:25:1210129014:1.source_cn: 对了，那东西还会唱歌，歌声像有钩子一样。

choice_prompt:27:1210129017.female: The Whispers fought off the Graveborns, but there was nothing they could do about the kraken. No cannon is big enough to hurt that thing.

say:28:1210129018:0.text: Well, they're the only ones fighting the Water Wights... Having someone like that is better than nothing. Otherwise, Rustport is gonna be called Deadport soon.
say:28:1210129018:0.source_cn: 他们和水鬼帮打得天昏地暗，抓间谍比吃饭还勤快……凑合吧...

say:30:1210129019:0.text: Wait a minute... If no one can leave, aren't we stuck here?!
say:30:1210129019:0.source_cn: 等一下，要是借不到船，我们不就被困在这里了？！

say:31:1210129020:0.text: Welcome to Rustport, where everyone's stuck, and we have a monster as our neighbor.
say:31:1210129020:0.source_cn: 欢迎来到锈锚港，伙计们！我们已经被困好久了。

say:33:1210129021:0.text: There must be a way out... Magister, let's go ask someone...
say:33:1210129021:0.source_cn: 一定有办法出去的，主人，我们再问问看吧……

say:36:1210129023:0.text: Alright, a place to rest... There's the <style="highlight">Golden Guest Inn in the lower district</style>. They have a dirty sign outside in the shape of a wine glass.

say:37:1210129024:0.text: Thank you for the information. Let's go there right away.

say:38:1210129025:1.text: Come here, Chippy. You can lean on me as we walk.
say:38:1210129025:1.source_cn: 满满，来扶着我，我们慢慢走……

choice:35:0:1.text: We need to find a place to rest.
choice:35:0:1.male: We need to find a place to rest.
choice:35:0:1.female: We need to find a place to rest.

choice:35:1:2.text: We can plan after we rest.
choice:35:1:2.male: We can plan after we rest.
choice:35:1:2.female: We can plan after we rest.

choice:27:0:1.text: You all listen to the Whispers?
choice:27:0:1.male: You all listen to the Whispers?
choice:27:0:1.female: You all listen to the Whispers?

choice:27:1:2.text: Are you all under their protection?
choice:27:1:2.male: Are you all under their protection?
choice:27:1:2.female: Are you all under their protection?

say:40:1210129015:1.text: If that was true, everyone here would be dead by now.
say:40:1210129015:1.source_cn: 怎么可能。那我们早完蛋了。

say:41:1210129016:1.text: It started appearing after the <style="highlight">Graveborn pirates</style> attacked Rustport. It also appears every time with that weird fog.

choice:19:0:1.text: Why can't we get a ship?
choice:19:0:1.male: Why can't we get a ship?
choice:19:0:1.female: Why can't we get a ship?

choice:19:1:2.text: There are so many ships here...
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 明明码头停着这么多艘……？
choice:19:1:2.male: There are so many ships here...
choice:19:1:2.female: There are so many ships here...

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 欢迎回到我们身边，小骑士！

say:0:1210130001:0.text: Here it is. Let's head in.
say:0:1210130001:0.source_cn: 到了，这就是。直接进去就行。

say:2:1210132001:0.text: Hello, we would like to stay the night. One of our friends isn't feeling well.
say:2:1210132001:0.source_cn: 您好，我们有人身体不适，可以留宿一晚上吗？

say:4:1210132003:0.text: Umm... we seem to have lost all our money when our boat sank...
say:4:1210132003:0.source_cn: 呃，之前落水的时候，我们的钱袋都遗失了……

say:5:1210132004:0.text: I don't do charity. You can go outside and find a shack to sleep in.
say:5:1210132004:0.source_cn: 老子不搞慈善，出门找个窝棚睡去吧。

say:7:1210132005:0.text: Hey, Bols! These are my guests.
say:7:1210132005:0.source_cn: 嘿，嘿，老兄！这是我带来的人。

say:8:1210132006:0.text: Let's talk privately for a minute.

say:13:1210132007:0.text: It's you again... Who are these people?
say:13:1210132007:0.source_cn: 又是你，说，这群人什么来头？

say:14:1210132008:0.text: I found them at the beach. Look here...

say:16:1210132010:0.text: Yes, please <style="highlight">take good care of these friends</style>.

say:17:1210132011:0.text: Well, you came just in time. The kitchen just finished cooking. Grab yourselves something to eat.
say:17:1210132011:0.source_cn: 刚好厨房做好了饭，你们先吃吧。

say:22:1210132012:0.text: Oh, we don't need to pay?

say:23:1210132013:0.text: Well, I don't usually do good deeds, but Sinbad convinced me.
say:23:1210132013:0.source_cn: 老子难得发一回善心，善心无价，你能出多少？

say:24:1210132014:0.text: Bols and I go way back. You guys can stay here.
say:24:1210132014:0.source_cn: 波尔斯和我有点交情，你们安心在这住着。

say:25:1210132015:1.text: Go get something to eat. I gotta go.
say:25:1210132015:1.source_cn: 那你们就吃着，我先走了。

say:0:1210134001:0.text: You done eating? If you want to get some rest, go upstairs. Room two.
say:0:1210134001:0.source_cn: 吃完了？想休息就上楼，楼上第二间。

say:1:1210134002:0.text: We're lucky that we met so many kindhearted people.
say:1:1210134002:0.source_cn: 我们真是遇上了不少好心人。

say:2:1210134003:0.text: Chippy, let me help you upstairs.

narration:0:1210135001:0.source_cn: 风雨交加的一晚终于过去了……

say:3:1210136002:1.text: I went to check, and our clothes are already dry.
say:3:1210136002:1.source_cn: 刚刚去摸了摸，你的衣服和靴子已经都烘干啦。
say:3:1210136002:1.male: I went to check, and our clothes are already dry.
say:3:1210136002:1.female: I went to check, and our clothes are already dry.

say:5:1210136004:1.text: Yes, Chippy is feeling much better!

say:6:1210136005:1.text: So, what's for breakfast? Fish stew? Yummy!
say:6:1210136005:1.source_cn: 哇，这早饭是什么，焖鱼片吗？好好吃！
say:6:1210136005:1.male: So, what's for breakfast? Fish stew? Yummy!
say:6:1210136005:1.female: So, what's for breakfast? Fish stew? Yummy!

choice_prompt:7:1210136005.male: So, what's for breakfast? Fish stew? Yummy!
choice_prompt:7:1210136005.female: So, what's for breakfast? Fish stew? Yummy!

say:8:1210136006:0.text: Remember not to push yourselves too much. We all need a few days of rest. The innkeeper was nice enough not to charge us for all of this. We need to thank him before we go.
say:8:1210136006:0.source_cn: 你们都别逞强哦，最好再多休息几天。多亏店老板好心，没收...

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 能主动吃东西我就放心了

say:2:1210138001:0.text: You all look like you've been resting well.

say:3:1210138002:0.text: Oh, hello! We were just talking about you.
say:3:1210138002:0.source_cn: 呀，你好！我们正说到你呢——

say:4:1210138003:0.text: Enough pleasantries. It's time for you to pay up.

say:5:1210138004:0.text: What?! Didn't you say yesterday that we didn't need to pay?
say:5:1210138004:0.source_cn: 诶？！昨天不是说不用给钱吗？

say:6:1210138005:0.text: Because of Sinbad, I let you stay here on credit. No one ever said free.
say:6:1210138005:0.source_cn: 看在辛巴达那混小子的份上，老子允许你们赊账，哪句话说给...

say:7:1210138006:0.text: You also ate all the fish that was meant for the Whispers' boss, and now you want to skip out on the bill?!
say:7:1210138006:0.source_cn: 店里准备上供给血薇帮老大的鱼，都被你们吃了，还想赖账？！
say:7:1210138006:0.male: You also ate all the fish that was meant for the Whispers' boss, and now you want to skip out on the bill?!

say:9:1210138007:0.text: It's a signature dish of the Golden Guest Inn—damedangler daube.
say:9:1210138007:0.source_cn: 那是本地特产，客金旅店招牌菜——红焖冥湾美人！

say:10:1210138008:0.text: What...?! Wasn't this a free breakfast? I mean it was just left out on the kitchen table...
say:10:1210138008:0.source_cn: 啊……！这不是免费的早饭吗？就随便地放在厨房桌子上……

say:11:1210138009:0.text: When is anything free? Even the old planks from the docks are worth something!
say:11:1210138009:0.source_cn: 锈锚港连破木板都能卖上价，什么时候有过免费的东西？！

say:12:1210138010:0.text: Pay up or get me a new fish!
say:12:1210138010:0.source_cn: 掏钱，不然就给老子把上供的鱼补上！

say:13:1210138011:1.text: Don't be so mean. It was just a fish.
say:13:1210138011:1.source_cn: 别这么凶，不就是一条鱼——

say:14:1210138012:0.text: It wasn't just a fish, you flaming mudfoots. You ate a <style="highlight">damedangler</style>. They only appear in <style="highlight">Blackwood Loch</style> this time of year. They're very difficult to catch.
say:14:1210138012:0.source_cn: 哼，不识货的旱鬼，你们吃的是<style=highli...

say:15:1210138013:0.text: Either pay up or get me that fish, otherwise...
say:15:1210138013:0.source_cn: 要么给钱，要么交鱼，不然——

say:16:1210138014:0.text: This sea rat stays and works off your debt!
say:16:1210138014:0.source_cn: 这耗子就留下来做工抵债吧！

say:19:1210138017:0.text: You...! You scoundrel! Chippy hasn't even recovered yet!
say:19:1210138017:0.source_cn: 你……！满满还没恢复好，你这是欺负人！

say:20:1210138018:0.text: I'm the scoundrel?! Who's the one not paying their debts? Give me what I want or I'm calling the Carmine Whispers!
say:20:1210138018:0.source_cn: 吃饭住店不给钱，谁欺负谁？拿东西来换他。不然老子叫血薇...
say:20:1210138018:0.male: I'm the scoundrel?! Who's the one not paying their debts? Give me what I want or I'm calling the Carmine Whispers!
say:20:1210138018:0.female: I'm the scoundrel?! Who's the one not paying their debts? Give me what I want or I'm calling the Carmine Whispers!

choice_prompt:21:1210138018.text: I'm the scoundrel?! Who's the one not paying their debts? Give me what I want or I'm calling the Carmine Whispers!
choice_prompt:21:1210138018.source_cn: 吃饭住店不给钱，谁欺负谁？拿东西来换他。不然老子叫血薇帮的人来！
choice_prompt:21:1210138018.male: I'm the scoundrel?! Who's the one not paying their debts? Give me what I want or I'm calling the Carmine Whispers!
choice_prompt:21:1210138018.female: I'm the scoundrel?! Who's the one not paying their debts? Give me what I want or I'm calling the Carmine Whispers!

say:22:1210138019:0.text: Hey, take it easy. I'm not gonna do anything to this rat as long as you get my fish.
say:22:1210138019:0.source_cn: 哎，哎，伙计，别紧张。老子不会对这小耗子怎么样，只要你...

say:23:1210138020:0.source_cn: 你这么凶又这么阴险，我们凭什么相信你？！

say:24:1210138021:0.text: The Golden Guest Inn has been operating in Rustport for twenty years. My reputation speaks for itself. Me and this inn aren't going anywhere.
say:24:1210138021:0.source_cn: 拿老子客金旅店在锈锚港二十年的声誉做担保，你们就算走了...

say:25:1210138031:0.text: How do we know what you're saying is true?
say:25:1210138031:0.source_cn: 我们、我们怎么知道你说的是真的？

say:26:1210138032:0.text: We don't even know if these dame-whatevers really exist!
say:26:1210138032:0.source_cn: 连你说的那种鱼——叫什么什么美人的，我们也不知道到底有没有！

say:27:1210138033:0.text: Go outside and ask anyone in Rustport. Damedanglers are native to waters around here, and the boss of the Carmine Whispers orders one every week.
say:27:1210138033:0.source_cn: 你出门随便找个人打听打听，谁都知道冥湾美人是锈锚港响当...
say:27:1210138033:0.male: Go outside and ask anyone in Rustport. Damedanglers are native to waters around here, and the boss of the Carmine Whispers orders one every week.
say:27:1210138033:0.female: Go outside and ask anyone in Rustport. Damedanglers are native to waters around here, and the boss of the Carmine Whispers orders one every week.

choice_prompt:28:1210138033.male: Go outside and ask anyone in Rustport. Damedanglers are native to waters around here, and the boss of the Carmine Whispers orders one every week.
choice_prompt:28:1210138033.female: Go outside and ask anyone in Rustport. Damedanglers are native to waters around here, and the boss of the Carmine Whispers orders one every week.

say:29:1210138034:0.text: Yes! If it's so valuable, why did you leave it on the kitchen table? You did that on purpose, didn't you?
say:29:1210138034:0.source_cn: 对！既然这么珍贵，为什么就随便放在厨房让人拿？你们故意的？！

say:30:1210138035:0.text: So, what if I did? Did I ask you to eat my fish? Either pay up or get me another one.
say:30:1210138035:0.source_cn: 是又怎么样？反正现在鱼已经进了你们肚子，不赔钱就赔鱼吧！

say:31:1210138038:0.text: I-I can't believe you're doing this!

choice_prompt:32:1210138038.text: I-I can't believe you're doing this!

say:35:1210138042:0.text: Oh, I see that look in your eyes, Magister, but don't fight them! Chippy doesn't want to see you get hurt... After all, there are so many of them.
say:35:1210138042:0.source_cn: 主人，别！满满不想看到主人受伤……毕竟他们人多。
say:35:1210138042:0.male: Oh, I see that look in your eyes, Magister, but don't fight them! Chippy doesn't want to see you get hurt... After all, there are so many of them.
say:35:1210138042:0.female: Oh, I see that look in your eyes, Magister, but don't fight them! Chippy doesn't want to see you get hurt... After all, there are so many of them.

say:36:1210138043:1.text: We can't leave you behind, Chippy...

say:37:1210138044:0.text: Don't worry! Chippy can take care of himself. Chippy is a knight, remember!
say:37:1210138044:0.source_cn: 别担心，满满会保护好自己的，别忘了我可是骑士！

say:41:1210138046:0.text: Don't be discouraged, friend. If you catch this fish for the Carmine Whispers, you may even curry favor from them.
say:41:1210138046:0.source_cn: 朋友，别沮丧，也别犹豫。往好了想，这鱼你要是钓来送给血...

say:42:1210138047:0.text: So, hurry up and go fishing. If you really want to beat me up, at least get me that fish first.
say:42:1210138047:0.source_cn: 快去钓鱼吧，就算要揍我，也请先把鱼拿来。

say:43:1210138048:1.text: Hmph! After we catch that fish, we're coming back for Chippy, and then...
say:43:1210138048:1.source_cn: 哼，等我们钓到鱼，换回满满，就……就……
say:43:1210138048:1.male: Hmph! After we catch that fish, we're coming back for Chippy, and then...
say:43:1210138048:1.female: Hmph! After we catch that fish, we're coming back for Chippy, and then...

choice_prompt:44:1210138048.text: Hmph! After we catch that fish, we're coming back for Chippy, and then...
choice_prompt:44:1210138048.source_cn: 哼，等我们钓到鱼，换回满满，就……就……
choice_prompt:44:1210138048.male: Hmph! After we catch that fish, we're coming back for Chippy, and then...
choice_prompt:44:1210138048.female: Hmph! After we catch that fish, we're coming back for Chippy, and then...

choice:44:0:1.text: We're going to beat you up!
choice:44:0:1.male: We're going to beat you up!
choice:44:0:1.female: We're going to beat you up!

choice:32:0:1.text: Is this how guests are treated in Rustport?
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 这就是锈锚港的待客之道？
choice:32:0:1.male: Is this how guests are treated in Rustport?
choice:32:0:1.female: Is this how guests are treated in Rustport?

say:47:1210138039:0.text: Let me put it this way. It doesn't matter if it's merchants, smugglers, or tourists, if you owe a debt, you gotta leave something valuable behind.
say:47:1210138039:0.source_cn: 这样说吧，这里往来的黑商和旅行者，多半都要留下点什么来...

choice:32:1:2.text: Rustport is a tough place to live.
choice:32:1:2.male: Rustport is a tough place to live.
choice:32:1:2.female: Rustport is a tough place to live.

say:50:1210138040:0.text: That's a compliment in this city. You can't claim you've been here if nothing valuable was taken from you.
say:50:1210138040:0.source_cn: 谢谢夸奖啊。不在锈锚港留下点什么，怎么算到过这里呢？

choice:32:2:3.text: I'll tell the Carmine Whispers about you.
choice:32:2:3.male: I'll tell the Carmine Whispers about you.
choice:32:2:3.female: I'll tell the Carmine Whispers about you.

say:51:1210138041:0.text: Actually, I was thinking the same thing! But we ate their fish... That will be hard to explain... especially since Chippy ate most of it.
say:51:1210138041:0.source_cn: 其实我也想到了！但是我们吃的鱼本来就是血薇帮的……我们...
say:51:1210138041:0.male: Actually, I was thinking the same thing! But we ate their fish... That will be hard to explain... especially since Chippy ate most of it.
say:51:1210138041:0.female: Actually, I was thinking the same thing! But we ate their fish... That will be hard to explain... especially since Chippy ate most of it.

choice:32:3:4.text: I want to beat you up so bad!
choice:32:3:4.male: I want to beat you up so bad!
choice:32:3:4.female: I want to beat you up so bad!

choice:28:0:1.text: Why was it left out so casually then?
choice:28:0:1.male: Why was it left out so casually then?
choice:28:0:1.female: Why was it left out so casually then?

say:52:1210138036:0.text: Yes, you keep mentioning the Carmine Whispers. Are you threatening us or something?
say:52:1210138036:0.source_cn: 你一直强调这是血薇帮的东西，是在威胁我们吗？

say:53:1210138037:0.text: Well, yeah. Rustport belongs to the Whispers. You better learn that before you get hurt.
